notes.title: THREAT VECTOR is an action sci-fi horror FPS coming from KillPixel Games
notes.content:
KillPixel Games, one of the dev teams responsible for WRATH: Aeon of Ruin, have announced their next game with THREAT VECTOR.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/01/threat-vector-is-an-action-sci-fi-horror-fps-coming-from-killpixel-games/
